title: Unit 3 Ratio and proportion: Direct and inverse proportion

q.Q2: Q2. 5 notebooks cost $8.75. Find the cost of 12 notebooks.
q.Q3: Q3. A 500 g pack costs $3.20 and a 750 g pack costs $4.65. Which is the better buy? Show your working.

q.Q5: Q5. It takes 5 people 12 hours to paint a hall. How long would it take 3 people working at the same rate?

q.Q6: Q6. Concrete is made from cement, sand and gravel in the ratio 1 : 2 : 4. How much sand is needed to make 350 kg of concrete?

q.Q7: Q7. A school has enough food to feed 120 students for 15 days. If 30 more students join, how many days will the food last? Explain whether this is direct or inverse proportion.
